purpose: Teach: シーア/難関/人民元/ウイグル/最高峰/浙江/広州/天空

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、シーア派多数地域での営業に配慮しろ
lines.en: Make sure our sales approach is considerate in Shia-majority regions.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. No rush — this is a priority worth stating clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。難関プロジェクトに精鋭を配置します
lines.en: Understood. I'll place our best people on the challenging projects.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight nod of the head. Calm, competent tone. Speaking as someone who is already thinking through logistics.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人民元決済の準備を進めろ
lines.en: Begin preparing our infrastructure for RMB settlement.
lines.style: Firm, strategic. Pause fractionally before the main clause. This is a financial decision with implications — delivered with that weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ウイグル関連の人権配慮を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. We'll be thorough about Uyghur-related human rights considerations.
lines.style: Professional, steady. Slight emphasis on 'thorough' — showing he's heard the priority. Not defensive, just clear about the commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界最高峰のサービスを目指せ
lines.style: Command-tone but not cold. Brief, confident. The voice of someone setting a bar he expects to be met.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。浙江省の供給網を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen our supply chain presence in Zhejiang Province.
lines.style: Efficient, forward-moving. Short sentences. The tone of someone who is already organizing resources mentally while speaking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、広州での営業所開設を検討しろ
lines.en: Consider opening a sales office in Guangzhou.
lines.style: Deliberate, measured. 'Consider' carries weight — this is exploratory but serious. Pause slightly before Guangzhou, letting the location register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。天空型ディスプレイ広告も検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also explore high-altitude display advertising options.
lines.style: Attentive wrap-up. Showing initiative by adding his own angle. Warm undertone — engaged, not just complying.
